headline: Vr Infraspace wins Rs 1.45 crore road work order from Panchayat R&B
summary: Vr Infraspace secured a Rs 1.45 crore confirmed order for road improvement in Amreli. The company's TTM revenue is reported as zero, highlighting a disconnect between recent order inflows and recognized earnings.

headline: Bhadora Industries wins Rs 9.62 Cr order for cable supply
summary: Bhadora Industries secured a Rs 9.62 crore work order from a domestic energy infrastructure company. This adds to a Q3FY27 inflow of Rs 77.28 crore, boosting the order book against low current revenue visibility.

headline: Presstonic wins Rs 1.48 Cr order from Titagarh for Mumbai Metro
summary: Presstonic Engineering secures Rs 1.48 Cr work order from Titagarh Rail Systems for Mumbai Metro Line 6 cable ducts. Order book coverage remains tight with Q3 inflow at Rs 1.42 Cr.

headline: CUDML secures Rs 7.01 cr railway ad order
summary: Cash Ur Drive Marketing has secured a Rs 7.01 crore order from Northern Railway for advertising rights at Chandigarh Station. This significant deal adds to its recent order inflows, which totaled Rs 23.28 crore over the last three quarters.

headline: PTC Industries to meet Franklin Templeton, SBI Life
summary: PTC Industries will host institutional investors including Franklin Templeton and SBI Life in Lucknow on November 27, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Tarai Foods Q2FY27 Results: Loss widens to ₹16.7 lakh
summary: Tarai Foods reported a net loss of ₹16.7 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹12.2 lakh in Q2FY26, with zero revenue from operations for the quarter.

headline: Coal India subsidiary MCL files IPO prospectus
summary: Mahanadi Coalfield Limited filed its IPO prospectus with RoC Odisha on November 23, 2026. The offer involves up to 66.18 crore equity shares via Offer for Sale.

headline: PTC Industries to host investor meetings in Asia
summary: PTC Industries Ltd will conduct one-on-one investor meetings in Singapore and Hong Kong from November 30 to December 3, 2026.

headline: Cyient DLM to host investor meets in HK and Singapore
summary: Cyient DLM Limited will participate in non-deal roadshows in Hong Kong and Singapore from November 30 to December 3, 2026. Key leadership including MD & CEO Rajendra Velagapudi will attend.

headline: AXISCADES incorporates UK aerospace subsidiary
summary: AXISCADES Technologies Ltd incorporated Akkodis AXISCADES Aerospace Engineering UK Limited in the UK on November 23, 2026, via its subsidiary Ulosia Holding AG.

headline: AGI Infra wins Forbes Asia Best Under A Billion award
summary: AGI Infra has won Forbes Asia's Best Under A Billion award for the third consecutive year at a forum held in Hong Kong on November 23, 2026.

headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn to raise funds via NCDs
summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Ltd board meeting on Nov 27, 2026, will approve raising funds through private placement of Non-Convertible Debentures.

headline: LTM Ltd seeks shareholder nod for Anupam Kumar
summary: LTM Limited has initiated a postal ballot to appoint Anupam Kumar, CEO of L&T Realty, as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. Voting concludes December 24, 2026.

headline: Clean Max sells 26% stake in Gangotri unit
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions approved the sale of 26% equity in Clean Max Gangotri to Gujarat Alkalies. The company will also invest up to ₹214.49 crore in the subsidiary.

headline: Silver Touch wins Rs 8.6 crore order from GUVNL
summary: Silver Touch Technologies secures Rs 8.6 crore work order from GUVNL for IT infrastructure. Book-to-bill remains low at 0.11x, but quarterly revenue execution is steady.

headline: Shetron Ltd seeks shareholder approval for director appointments
summary: Shetron Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the appointment of three directors and approval of Executive Chairman terms. E-voting opens November 26, 2026.

headline: Zydus Lifesciences sets up Australian subsidiary
summary: Zydus Lifesciences has incorporated ZyduS Australia Pty. Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to distribute pharmaceutical products in Australia.

headline: GSK India launches BLENREP for multiple myeloma
summary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited launched BLENREP in India for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. The therapy nearly triples progression-free survival vs standard care.

headline: Borosil Renewables to host virtual investor meet on Dec 2
summary: Borosil Renewables Limited will participate in the Yes Securities India Manthan Virtual Forum 2026 on December 2, 2026. The event is scheduled for 9:00 am IST and will be conducted virtually.

headline: EBIX board meeting postponed to Nov 28 for Q1FY27 results
summary: EBIX Limited postponed its board meeting from November 24 to November 28, 2026, due to medical exigencies. The meeting will approve Q1FY27 financial results.

headline: Finkurve receives ₹30 crore from warrant conversion
summary: Finkurve Financial Services received ₹30 crore towards the balance subscription amount for share warrants issued in May 2025, strengthening its capital base for expansion.

headline: Polycab India schedules investor meets with Enam AMC, Wellington
summary: Polycab India will host one-on-one meetings with institutional investors including Enam AMC, Wellington Management, and Schonfeld Strategic Advisors between December 1 and 4, 2026.

headline: Novus Loyalty wins two awards at Elets BFSI Summit
summary: Novus Loyalty Limited's AI-led programs for Central Bank of India and IDBI Bank won top honors at the Elets BFSI AI 50 Summit 2026, validating its platform.

headline: EverestIMS H1FY27: Revenue up 18%, PAT down 9%
summary: EverestIMS Technologies reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹2,769.77 lakh, up 17.93% YoY. However, net profit fell 9.38% to ₹256.47 lakh as margins contracted due to higher operating costs.

headline: Unifinz Capital plans ₹1,000 crore NCD issuance
summary: Unifinz Capital India Ltd's committee will meet on Nov 30 to approve raising up to ₹1,000 crore via private placement of non-convertible debentures.

headline: Dev IT Q2FY27 revenue up 28% to ₹63 crore
summary: Dev Information Technology Ltd reported a 28% YoY rise in Q2FY27 total income to ₹63.07 crore. EBITDA grew 37% to ₹5.21 crore, with margins improving to 8.26%.

headline: Carraro India to host investor meet on Dec 9
summary: Carraro India Limited will participate in the Centrum Broking Limited investor conference in Mumbai on December 9, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Mach Travel pays ₹1.75 lakh compounding fee
summary: Mach Travel Solutions received an interim order for a ₹1.75 lakh compounding fee over a procedural default regarding auditor appointment in FY20.

headline: Hyundai Motor India hikes prices up to ₹8,000
summary: Hyundai Motor India announced a price hike of up to ₹8,000 on select models effective December 1, 2026, citing rising input costs.

headline: Ideaforge to host investor meet on Nov 30
summary: Ideaforge Technology will participate in Antique's Aerospace & Defence Conference in Mumbai on November 30, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Gland Pharma VSEZ oncology unit gets USFDA NAI status
summary: Gland Pharma's VSEZ sterile oncology facility has received a 'No Action Indicated' classification from the USFDA following a GMP inspection, signalling full regulatory compliance.

headline: HCG updates official website address
summary: HealthCare Global Enterprises changed its official website to hcghospitals.com effective November 24, 2026, per SEBI Regulation 46.

headline: Fujiyama Power shareholders approve QIP
summary: Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd shareholders passed a special resolution to raise funds via Qualified Institutions Placement. The vote saw 99.99% support from polled shares.
